Private or insurance work, one panel or the whole car. Send photos and we'll tell you what it needs.

Accident repairs
  1. 01 Accident repairsPanels straightened, repaired or replaced after a knock, then painted to match.
  2. 02 Spray paintingSingle panels to full resprays, colour-matched and blended into the panels next to them.
  3. 03 Dents & creasesDents worked out of the panel wherever it can be saved, not replaced.
  4. 04 Insurance claim quotesA detailed repair quote for your insurer or assessor, from your photos or an inspection.
  5. 05 Bumper repairsCracked, torn or scuffed plastic bumpers repaired and painted.
  6. 06 Scratches & scuffsKeyed doors and scraped corners flatted and refinished.
  7. 07 Rust repairRust cut out, treated and repaired before it spreads into the panel.
  8. 08 Machine polishingDull, oxidised paint machine-polished back to a shine.
